decision.explanation: Document d2 explicitly states that 'The Council of Chief State School Officers (CCSSO) today announced that Tabatha Rosproy [...] is the 2021 [National Teacher of the Year]'. This directly supports the claim that Tabatha Rosproy was named the 2021 National Teacher of the Year. Document d3 similarly claims this honor for Juliana Urtubey, but since both cannot be correct for the same title in the same year, and only d2 is retained as consistent with the official announcement, only Tabatha Rosproy is accepted.
